title: Count text characters
summary: Bash: Count text characters. Try a five-letter name.
introduction: ${#name} gives the length of the variable value. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The # length form counts the four characters in Asha.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: For these examples use simple English letters so character counting is clear.
